+title: Move DeterministicEmbedder into ExamplesSupport
+---
+## What
+
+`DeterministicEmbedder` is the GPU-free `TextEmbedding` that replaces the live-Router embedder in every demo. It is public today, but it lives in one demo target: `Examples/HotReloadCore/HotReloadCore.swift:73`.
+
+Move it to the shared `Examples/ExamplesSupport/` target so `SemanticSearchCore` can use it too. `ExamplesSupport` depends only on the main library target, so it stays GPU-free and Router-free.
+
+Files to change:
+- `Examples/ExamplesSupport/DeterministicEmbedder.swift` — new file. Move the type, its doc comment, and the `// MARK: - GPU-free deterministic embedder` section from `HotReloadCore.swift:63-...` unchanged.
+- `Examples/HotReloadCore/HotReloadCore.swift` — delete the moved type. Add `import ExamplesSupport` if it is absent.
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsMetadataRegistryTests/` — update any test that names `HotReloadCore.DeterministicEmbedder`.
+
+Do not change the type's behavior. This is a move only.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `DeterministicEmbedder` is declared in `Examples/ExamplesSupport/DeterministicEmbedder.swift` and nowhere else.
+- [ ] `HotReloadCore` still compiles and still defaults its `embedder` parameter to `DeterministicEmbedder()`.
+- [ ] `ExamplesSupport` gains no new target dependency in `Package.swift`.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMetadataRegistryTests/HotReloadTests.swift` — the existing burst tests still pass unchanged, proving the moved embedder behaves the same.
+- [ ] Add a test in `Tests/FoundationModelsMetadataRegistryTests/ExamplesSmokeTests.swift` that calls `DeterministicEmbedder(dimension: 8).embed(["a", "b"])` and asserts two vectors of length 8, and that the same input gives the same output twice.
+- [ ] Run `swift test`. All tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
